title: Power BI: data model, measures and publishing

videos.script: In many companies, business intelligence simply means Power BI. It is the tool most job advertisements name. {{ads}} It is also a Windows program, and this course was recorded on Linux. So this lesson does something unusual. Every formula is shown beside the SQL that computes the same number. The SQL was run. The formulas were not. {{side}} That turns out to be a good way to learn it. Power BI's formula language, DAX, is short to write and hard to reason about. {{dax}} What makes it hard is the filter context. A measure has no fixed value. In every cell of a table it is computed again, under that cell's filters. {{context}} In SQL you already know this. It is a where clause and a group by that you did not write. {{sql}} You will rebuild lesson three's star as a Power BI model, write measures, change their filters, compare with last year, and limit what one manager can see. {{model}} And you will see what publishing costs, and why. {{end}}
